### Unverifiable

The body itself discloses this as checkable only on the authoring machine, so this is self-flagged, not a surprise finding.

### Property walk

- Scoped: every diff hunk (including the one-line `git-workflow/SKILL.md` change and the `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md` severity-table/hard-wrap edits) is a mechanical consequence of a change the body names; `git grep` across the fixture head found no stray `Must Fix`/`Should Fix`/`Nice to Have` remnants left inconsistent elsewhere.
